'''ViGureni''' was a continent located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]]. The [[Coromon Islands]], which were located in the [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] north of the planet, were to the west of ViGureni.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
ViGureni was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
